name: Tatiana Suarez

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (65 in height, 66 in reach, Southpaw, born 1990-12-19); strawweight (115 lb). Last fight in the data: UFC 327, Apr 11, 2026 (submission win over Loopy Godinez). She is booked against Virna Jandiroba at UFC Vegas 124 on Nov 7, 2026, the day after this sheet; no fight-week photos were published yet.

photo_coverage: Good. Frontal studio headshot and two full-body studio cut-outs (one with braids, one with a slicked-back ponytail that shows the hairline), a clean right-side profile from the UFC 327 ceremonial weigh-in (Apr 2026), a three-quarter post-fight press still and a high-resolution three-quarter fight-night photo (both Apr 2026), plus three small UFC 327 action photos. Only one freely licensed photo (a 2018 interview still with older blonde-highlighted hair).

face.shape: Oval to slightly long face: high cheekbones, cheeks tapering to a moderately narrow jaw and a rounded chin. Lower face a little long relative to the midface.
face.jaw: Moderately defined, not wide; smooth jawline.
face.chin: Rounded, medium width, average height; in the right profile it sits slightly behind the line of the lips.
face.cheekbones: High and fairly prominent; slight hollow below them at fight weight.
face.forehead: Medium-high, smooth; with the ponytail the hairline is gently rounded with no recession.

eyes.shape: Almond, slightly deep-set with a visible lid crease and a little hooding at the outer corners; faint under-eye shadows.
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest MakeHuman iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Strongly arched with a defined, slightly angular peak about two-thirds out and tapering tails; groomed and dark: one of her strongest features.
eyebrows.colour: Dark brown (sample #492e25 is skin-tinted; render about #2e1e17).

nose.width: Narrow-to-medium bridge, medium tip and nostrils
nose.bridge: High and straight; in the right profile straight with a very slight convexity near the top
nose.tip: Defined, medium width, pointing level to very slightly down

face.mouth_lips: Medium-to-wide mouth; full lips, the upper lip notably full with a well-defined cupid's bow, lower lip full; at rest a slight pout with corners level or slightly down. Bright wide smile in press photos.

ears.size: Small-to-medium, close to the head, usually hidden by hair.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No obvious cauliflower ear on the visible left ear (UFC 327 close-up); the right ear is hidden in all photos.

face.marks_scars: Small dark tattoo just behind and below the left ear. No scars visible at this resolution, including on the front of the neck; do not model any.

hair.style: Fight and studio: centre part with two Dutch/French braids running back from the hairline, ending in long loose lengths or in plaits down the back (ESPN headshot, UFC 327 fight). Weigh-ins and media: long, loose, straight-to-softly-wavy hair, centre or slightly off-centre part (UFC 327 weigh-in). Also slicked back into a ponytail (studio cut-out).
hair.length_note: Reaches the middle of the back when loose.
hair.colour_note: Medium-dark brown at the roots, warming to lighter caramel-brown through the lengths and ends. The 2018 photo shows blonde balayage that has since grown out or been coloured over.
hair.avatar_choice: Fight look: braid texture on the scalp plus two plaits (ponytail01 split or retinted #5e3f2c). Loose look: long straight proxy if available; none shipped, so ponytail01 is the fallback.

skin.tone_hex_method: Plain RGB mean of the samples marked in_average (well-lit cheek patches; specular, coloured-light and 2018 video patches excluded); each sample is the mean of the 15th-85th luma-percentile pixels of the patch.
skin.tone_note: Light-medium olive-tan skin. Studio cheek samples run #b8745b to #d18e79 and the press-conference still is brighter (#e89e81); the body reads a touch lighter than the shaded cheeks. Tint toward #c98a6e for neutral lighting.
skin.freckles_marks: Faint freckles on the shoulders and chest in the studio cut-outs; no other marks.

body.build: Athletic, strong wrestler's build for a strawweight and relatively tall for the division: broad, rounded shoulders, toned arms, solid thighs.
body.body_fat_note: Upper abdominals and obliques visible in the studio cut-outs; lower abdomen smooth.
body.shoulders: Broad for 115 lb, rounded deltoids; visible trapezius.
body.arms: Toned and strong rather than bulky; defined deltoids and triceps.
body.legs_calves: Solid, powerful thighs (wrestler), athletic calves; legs proportionate to slightly long.
body.posture: Upright, square, calm, chin level; serious expression in face-offs.
body.notable: Strong arched brows, long straight nose and full lips are the main face cues; long braided brown hair is the main fight-night cue.

tattoos.where: Outer front of the right thigh, just below the shorts hem
tattoos.description: Mandala-style design: black linework with pointed petals and teal/green shading.

tattoos.where: Left lower shin just above the ankle, front/inner side
tattoos.description: Small outline heart with a looping line (ribbon-like), dark ink.

tattoos.where: Left side of the neck just behind/below the left ear
tattoos.description: Small dark (blue-black) tattoo; design not resolvable at this size.

tattoos_note: Thigh piece seen clearly in espn_stance_left.png (right leg, outer side); it is hidden by the shorts or the angle in the other cut-out. Ankle heart on the LEFT leg in the same cut-out. Neck tattoo only in the Apr 2026 Getty close-up.

kit.fight_kit_recent: Blue Venum sports bra and shorts with a darker blue wave print, black waistband with white UFC logo, 'SUAREZ' in red lettering on the shorts; red wrist tape (UFC 327, Apr 2026).
kit.studio_kits: Blue Venum/crypto.com set with a black wave print (cut-out 1) and blue Venum tiger-stripe set (cut-out 2).
kit.weigh_in: US flag draped over the shoulders at the UFC 327 ceremonial weigh-in.

stance_and_guard_observed.from_photos: UFC 327 action photos show her extending both hands to frame and catch kicks and lifting opponents from a low level change; posture is wrestler-forward. Not enough frames to set guard values; leave those to the scouting-based stance block.

morphs_extra_macro.note: Outside the requested list but in the shipped manifest; neutral athletic values.

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets are not in assets/embed/mh-manifest.json. Ears are small and close to the head; no shaping needed.

morphs_unavailable: Height: no heightUpF/heightDownF given (the research/assets.md fit is for the male base); build at the female default and scale to 165.1 cm. Braids and the three tattoos need texture work.

render_hints.hair: fight: two Dutch braids + plaits, #5e3f2c with lighter ends

notes: Confidence: high for brows, nose, lips, hair, build and tattoos (studio cut-outs plus Apr 2026 photos); medium for exact morph values and chin depth. Watch for: (1) thick, high-arched dark brows; (2) long straight high-bridged nose; (3) full upper lip with a strong cupid's bow; (4) long brown hair with lighter ends, braided for fights; (5) mandala on the outer RIGHT thigh, heart above the LEFT ankle, small mark behind the LEFT ear; (6) do not use the 2018 Commons still for hair or skin colour.
